_comment: Hearthbound: villager_warship-1.0.0 fabric 1.20.1.jar hardcodes this structure's biomes as an INLINE list, so no datapack tag merge can reach it — it generated ONLY in deep_cold_ocean, deep_lukewarm_ocean, deep_ocean, in RU territory as much as in BWG's. Full-file override, identical to stock except the biomes list. a deep-ocean shipwreck — extended to the RU and Hybrid Aquatic biomes that already self-tag #minecraft:is_deep_ocean. Re-derive from the jar with .claude/tools/gen-inline-structure-overrides.js if the mod updates.
